scope: Corrected V0.2 reproduction, one new Teacher training run and two frozen-Teacher Student seeds.

training.unchanged_native_student: Reward, observations, 18D actions, termination, randomization, network and PPO configuration retained.

evaluation.rule: Both command ages >=2s; >=100 scored steps; >=80% simultaneous four-way compliance and each scored RMSE within tolerance; timeout alone is insufficient.

limitations: One Teacher training run; two Student seeds are not independent Teacher replications.
Uniform/Fresh are reused runs, not newly retrained baselines.
Seed48 Fresh ran on RTX3060; Uniform and CleanMeta8 ran on RTX5060 Laptop. All seed49 methods ran on RTX3060.
Different Teacher interventions produce diverging Student trajectories; equal initialization does not pair every subsequent physical state.
PhysX restoration does not serialize hidden contact caches and is not a claim of bitwise determinism.
Legacy Meta8/Meta16 results came from the audited old implementation; they are not corrected-algorithm results.
Performance differences do not isolate the causal effect of the optimizer fix.
No consistent final-checkpoint advantage across both Student seeds; no statistical-significance or hardware-validation claim.
